title: Experiment: Conditional Credit Replenishment + Security Questionnaire Trigger
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: improve PLG conversion rate to paid (30-day uplift) while reducing credit abuse and accelerating enterprise-qualified leads. Hypothesis: offering a small conditional credit replenishment (one-time top-up) that is unlocked only after the account completes the security questionnaire (SQ) and a short product activation funnel will increase qualified upgrade rate without materially increasing free-tier spend.

Experiment summary: create a lightweight conditional replenish mechanic: users who exhaust the initial trial credits are offered a one-time top-up of 2,000 tokens valid for 7 days if they (a) complete a short security questionnaire (3–5 required fields tailored for discovery) and (b) trigger two product activation events (first successful embedding call + one generation > 64 tokens). Track conversion to paid, SQ completion rate, churn on free tier, and misuse signals.

Key trade-offs considered:
- Risk: additional credits could be gamed; mitigation via telemetry and abuse rules (rate limits, device/account heuristics).
- UX friction: requiring SQ may deter some individual devs; so only surface replenish for accounts showing medium intent signals (team invites, billing fields filled).
- Sales enablement: SQ completion creates a lead for AE outreach; need clear handoff data (answers, sample usage metrics).
metrics: primary: paid-conversion-30d (relative lift), secondary: sq-completion-rate, activation-event-rate, free-tier-spend-per-account, abuse-flag-rate (suspicious token velocity), sales-qualified-leads-created
acceptance_criteria: Server-side feature flag gating and A/B experiment rollout configured (target: 30% of new trial signups)
SQ flow built as embeddable modal with 5 fields, responses saved to customer profile and visible to Sales via CRM feed
One-time replenish grant logic implemented (2,000 tokens, 7d TTL) and visible in billing/console UI
Telemetry: events for credit_exhausted, sq_shown, sq_completed, activation_event_1, activation_event_2, replenish_granted, replenish_used
Safety: automated abuse heuristics (rate cap + velocity checks) integrated and documented
Dashboard: experiment dashboard with conversion funnel and cohort breakdown by vertical, region, and signup source
implementation_notes: Backend: Feature flag + experiment assignment (ENG). Use existing credit pipeline; implement TTL-based top-up record and idempotent grant. Frontend: small modal flow in signup/onboarding path (DES). CRM feed: webhook to Sales (CONFLUENCE/Drive spec below). Instrumentation: add Prometheus/Datadog metrics and send experiment events to analytics stream (Mixpanel/BigQuery).
risks_and_mitigations: Abuse: monitor abuse-flag-rate; automatic suspension of replenish for accounts with high velocity and manual review for borderline cases. Enterprise friction: allow B2B overflow path where sales can bypass SQ if contract in negotiation. Metric confounding: run for 6 weeks with p<0.05 powering; use holdout control for channel-level noise.
